evidence: Body loads two 32-bit values at arg+0x40, selects one of two global table entries according to whether the second is <= 0, loads an entry member, and passes it to lookup_attribute_context_value; caller examples pass nested object members. Specific semantic query is unclear. decompiled/main/main_0013.c:15571-15579; caller decompiled/main/main_0020.c:29784-29786.

Rejects selector values above 0x99 with 0xfffffffe; otherwise forwards the selector to validate_selector_and_lookup_code. Caller passes small selector values. decompiled/main/main_0119.c:20178-20184; caller decompiled/main/main_0120.c:2008-2011.

Iterates over a count from the input and sums results from sum_attribute_context_modifier_values, compares the sum with a 16-bit field at object+0xa4, then performs a second loop counting matching results and writes two status bytes at +0xa81/+0xa82. Exact meaning of those status bytes is not established. decompiled/main/main_0082.c:20746-20803; caller decompiled/main/main_0082.c:18229-18232.

Accumulates sum_attribute_context_modifier_values for each entry in the input count, then divides the 16-bit sum by an 8-bit count and returns the quotient; returns zero on invalid/empty paths. decompiled/main/main_0082.c:20929-20959; caller decompiled/main/main_0082.c:18382-18386.

Uses a numeric input to compute a complicated floating-point transform, clamps/remaps it through float_linear_range_remap_clamped, and returns an integer multiple of 100; constants and caller context do not establish the represented quantity. decompiled/main/main_0056.c:24198-24280; caller decompiled/main/main_0056.c:23726-23727.

Reads three color component bytes from an object, conditionally rearranges color bytes, then invokes three component setters and tailcalls an object update routine. Caller context associates this area with color fields and team-logo controls, but the exact helper role is unclear. decompiled/main/main_0078.c:49731-49772; caller decompiled/main/main_0078.c:43830.

Traverses up to a signed count of nested objects, checks provider availability and a byte flag at nested object+0xa2, then queries float values and returns a boolean indicating whether the traversal found a qualifying entry. Caller names show context-record initialization and contextual-player-attribute evaluation, but not the precise predicate. decompiled/main/main_0056.c:38727-38802; callers decompiled/main/main_0056.c:39397-39399 and 27957-27959.

Bounds-checks property index to 0..29, reads the indexed property id at object + index*4 + 0xa0, asks attribute_context_value_is_supported, and if supported retrieves two bytes from the returned descriptor and tests whether their sum is nonzero. decompiled/main/main_0087.c:45170-45199; caller decompiled/main/main_0087.c:41731-41734.

Validates an input status index in 1..5, reads status-indexed records and compares several fields and float values, then returns a boolean. Caller indices 1..5 but exact predicate cannot be inferred confidently. decompiled/main/main_0166.c:22495-22584; caller decompiled/main/main_0166.c:36952-36956.
